scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @helishou/infinite-canvas-backend run test && corepack pnpm --filter @basketikun/canvas-agent run test && corepack pnpm --filter infinite-canvas run test
scripts.predev: corepack pnpm run build:plugins && corepack pnpm --filter @basketikun/canvas-agent run build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run predev && concurrently -n backend,web "corepack pnpm --filter @helishou/infinite-canvas-backend run dev" "corepack pnpm --filter infinite-canvas run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: corepack pnpm run predev:backend && corepack pnpm --filter @helishou/infinite-canvas-backend run dev
scripts.predev:web: corepack pnpm run build:plugins && corepack pnpm --filter @basketikun/canvas-agent run build

scripts.dev:services: corepack pnpm run predev:services && concurrently -n backend,agent,web "corepack pnpm --filter @helishou/infinite-canvas-backend run dev" "corepack pnpm run dev:agent" "corepack pnpm --filter infinite-canvas run dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:plugins && corepack pnpm --filter @basketikun/canvas-agent run build && corepack pnpm --filter @helishou/infinite-canvas-backend run build && corepack pnpm --filter infinite-canvas run build
